request.subject: PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn it into a stone-age dugout canoe: the hull becomes a log of warm tawny wood, colour #a2804b; the bow becomes a small plesiosaur head painted deep blue #205794 with bold orange stripes; the red sail becomes dull sandy brown animal hide, colour #a67c3d, with big bold dark brown spots; the pennant becomes orange feathers. Keep the boat shape, mast, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
